# 5 bed cottage for sale

> Charming old style cottage nestled in a peaceful, private and tranquil setting in Muckross, Killarney. This picturesque cottage is located within 2 km of Killarney National Park and is adjacent to a private pond and stream. This property was extended in 2004 and measures 246 sqm (2,650 sq ft) with large living areas combined with natural light and old world charm.

## Fakta
- Typ: cottage
- Druh nabídky: sale
- Dispozice: 5 bed
- Plocha: 246 m²
- Energetická náročnost: D1
- Lokalita: Dolphin Cottage, Coolies, Muckross, Killarney
- Cena: 400 000 €
